name: Pi
summary: Pi is a minimal, extensible agent harness and coding agent CLI, developed by Earendil and created by Mario Zechner. It ships a small core and leaves out sub-agents, plan mode and permission prompts by design; users add them through TypeScript extensions, skills, prompt templates and Pi packages from npm or git. It runs interactively, in print/JSON mode, over RPC or embedded via an SDK.
facts: Not built in; add via extensions or packages
None built in; container or micro-VM patterns documented
goodFor: Building your own harness on a small core
Embedding an agent loop via SDK or RPC
watchOut: No permission system; runs with your user's rights
Issues and PRs from new contributors auto-closed by default
